tips.text: cs can draw a bar per prompt on its band, to scroll back to any prompt: run /config and turn on cs: Band: prompt bars
every cs setting is in one pane: run /cs, type to search, and press Enter on a row to change it

cs settings need no export in your shell: cs -config set <KEY> <value> keeps one for this machine, cs <name> -config set for one session, and cs -config list shows every setting and where its value comes from
to see only your prompts and Claude's answers in this session, run /filter-chat; run it again to show the work between them
